caption: The video captures a fixed overhead view of a scratched, stained metal surface holding two piles of glossy, viscous candy-like goo. On the left, a white lollipop stick lies diagonally across a flat smear of bright green goo, with a thin strand of green curling down from where the stick crosses the goo. On the right sits a larger rounded blob swirled with green, yellow and a streak of blue, its center mottled with orange-brown speckles. The only visible activity occurs inside this right-hand blob, where small bubbles slowly appear and shift within the green areas. A cluster of tiny bubbles forms and drifts in the lower-left green region, while a few specks flicker near the middle. The blob's outer outline, the white stick, the green smear on the left, and the background scratches all remain in fixed positions throughout. The camera stays still, so the subtle bubbling is the only motion in the scene.
